cause: Continuity was tested as isolated artifacts: the parallel gate assumed a host STATUS ledger while the portable profile standardized NEXT-SESSION-POINTER and claim sidecars, and no journey test connected adoption, claim creation, and the installed gate.
prevention: Treat continuity as one portable producer-consumer contract: when STATUS is absent, accept only a live canonical pointer that matches every active claim and existing handoff/log sidecar; fail closed for template placeholders, stale or malformed state, identity mismatch, and add a fresh-core adoption-to-first-claim regression plus doctor diagnostics.
summary: A fresh core installation accepted a default claim and then blocked its own governance gate because the gate required a STATUS artifact that the selected template and doctor did not provide.
title: Portable continuity must close the adoption-to-first-claim journey
